top_signals.title: Asian Tech Slide Sends Emerging-Market Stocks to Three-Month Low
top_signals.summary: The slide in the Asian tech stocks pushed the benchmark for emerging markets to the lowest in three months, though the pullback in oil prices helped shield European bourses and currencies from the selloff.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
